chk_scale.note: FLAG: no calipers (scan-only run, DECISIONS.md MEASUREMENTS); 0 ENV dims < 3; units assumed mm, scale unverified, no scale applied

primary.desc: flange plate back face (stem side, flat, ~290 mm2)
primary.why: mounting flange seating face: the two screw ears clamp this flat against the machine; largest clean moulded flat, all other features stand off it

xy.desc: boss collar OD around the drive tube (tray side)
xy.why: collar concentric with the valve rotor axis; clean moulded circle

xy.desc: crenellated drive tube OD, lower unslotted band
stem neck OD below the flange
xy.why: same valve axis; extends the tilt span to ~16 mm

origin.definition: valve axis (median circle centre of boss collar, drive tube and stem neck ODs) ∩ flange back face plane

clock.label_rule: 2-fold Fourier phase of flange-ear vertex mass; the ear nearest +90 deg in the levelled pre-clock frame goes to +X (the part is near-mirror-symmetric about the plane through the axis normal to the ears, so which ear is +X is a convention)
clock.why: the ears carry the mounting screws; ports then lie in the YZ plane

landmarks.name: tray floor (plate thickness)
landmarks.tol_source: provisional levelling offset histogram (explore1.py, 0.1 mm bins) +/- noise

landmarks.name: crenellated tube tip (top of part)
landmarks.tol_source: provisional levelling bounds; checks material side / sign

landmarks.name: port ends (bottom of part)
landmarks.tol_source: provisional levelling bounds; checks material side / sign
